scope: Artifact verified reader, signed downloads, anonymous namespace protection and provider privacy gate. Component/integration records below are targeted; final browser and scale acceptance are separate.

storage.note: Final narrow rerun adds case-insensitive namespace alias to the same parent; not additional parents.

file_http.initial_failure: New test expected503 but existing feature-disabled helper correctly returned403/private_storage_required; corrected expectation, product response unchanged.

initial_fixture_failures: Fixture-created Issue did not advance workspace issue_counter; synchronized fixture counter without relaxing production uniqueness.

frontend.note: 17 unique artifact cases validated across initial and three targeted instrument-only corrections, plus four new private-provider/file-picker cases. Locale suite overlaps earlier runs.

contracts: Downloaded bytes are spooled once and verified before HTTP headers/body; range requests use the same verified spool.
Capabilities expire after60seconds, bind actor/workspace/artifact/version/hash, and recheck current membership and immutable descriptor after I/O.

Anonymous LocalStorage ServeFile denies artifact namespace, normalized/encoded/case aliases, directory listings and symlink paths. Authorized GetReader remains usable; ordinary regular attachment reads retain behavior.
S3 and unknown providers fail closed for artifact file capture/download because the current configuration cannot confirm private object access; text artifacts remain a domain capability.
Download-link is metadata-only and does not assert current storage availability.
limitations: No real NAS or Agent was used for these checks.
No cloud bucket/CDN policy was changed or remotely probed.
Domain header/private submission recovery tests and full assembled API/browser acceptance are tracked separately.
The app cannot secure an operator-created separate static web server that exposes its local upload directory.
rollback_boundary: After any private artifact file is created, restoring an API without the new anonymous namespace protection can expose retained files through /uploads. Preserve the storage protection and artifact database guards during application rollback; otherwise stop file service and use an explicitly reviewed backup recovery or forward fix. The current resident release has no new artifact records and was not changed by this validation.
